value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 to 3 years with a parent - their site lists it for this fall, but I could not confirm the day, time or price. They also run Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly for 0+. Both need registration through Cartwheels' online sign-in, which shows pricing once logged in. I'll keep watching and text you when the details post.
